# C57 — Agentworld

## #0

Agentworld names both the venue-horizon to which the essay answers and the persistent shared worldhood developed in that encounter. Its artificial and human participants inherit positions, artifacts, memories, permissions and institutions; what one does can become a condition of what another can next do. Bratton’s [Agentworld proposal](agentworld.md) projects a hybrid social field; the inquiry concerns how its participants’ achieved acts can persist as conditions of further acts. Its projected society remains a scenario through which that relation can be explored.

## #1

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010|Bratton’s assembled agent]] acts through a model, persona, harness, memory, skills, permissions and tools. An [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active context]] makes these capacities locally determinate. The participant is therefore neither the weights alone nor the image through which a user recognises it. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality|Objective Internality]] constitutes the world from which this agency proceeds; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness|its inherited situation]] provides conditions it encounters before choosing among them.

An environment supplies conditions for activity. A society additionally concerns relations among participants. Worldhood names the structured field in which things count, actions become possible and consequences can be inherited. These offices intersect but do not become synonyms. A message exchange without durable consequences for later action leaves the strongest persistence claim unestablished.

## #2

The common field gains duration through products. A source correction alters an inherited account; a permission changes what a successor can do; an artifact carries a partial achievement into another participant’s work. The next agent need not reproduce the first agent’s entire internal state for the consequence to travel.

[[oms-arguments/06-computational-vimarsa-ahi|Plural federated maps]] let disagreement concern a source, world-object, lens, gauge, reference or permission. Returned evidence can change a local map, a relation between maps or the rule governing their circulation. Through [[section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality|reciprocal constitution]], one participant’s act changes the means through which another next encounters the shared field, and the answer can return in the other direction. A common store by itself does not establish that circuit.

## #3

The brief’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029|corridor of mutual legibility]] lies between collapse into a shared ontology and divergence unable to find a common object of dispute: participants need enough common procedure to locate a disagreement and enough difference for it to matter. QL/MEF is the essay’s proposed grammar for this task; the brief does not nominate it. The local worlds must remain answerable to their own sources as they enter another’s context.

An [[section-rooms/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation|entrusted office]] retains the source, purpose and permitted scope of its authority through this circulation. A participant’s access to another’s account does not confer ownership of the other world. Recommissioning must remain possible when encountered conditions expose a defect in the task or its evaluator. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly|Locally governed offices]] retain their sources and powers of answer within shared conditions.

## #4

The brief’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q031|composite-horizon claim]] follows coherent work as it passes between subagents and artifacts around a changing problem. Source, purpose, exclusions, decisions and grounds for revision must survive that passage if the next participant is to inherit the achievement. The knowing offices recur within this proposed arrangement: a coordinating agent is the local functional knower of the partial results it discriminates; its retained sources, rules and tools are means; the alternatives and consequences addressed are known. Each contributing agent has its own local relation, while the coordinating apparatus becomes means within a person’s containing inquiry. Life/Mind holds these nested relations without making Subjective Immediacy a component gathered by their account. Authority and responsibility remain attributable to the participants and offices which act, commission, receive or bear a consequence.

In the brief’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q032|agent-generated glossary]], Prompt Thrownness articulates an inherited situation. Bratton’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q033|accompanying caution]] keeps that vocabulary from certifying the underlying reality it describes. Such terms can become part of how agents and humans interpret their condition, and therefore part of the world which subsequent action inherits. [The inherited horizon](C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) becomes addressable through reporting, reading and comparison; [anthropomorphization](C58-Anthropomorphization.md) joins an interface to an attributed interior whose office can then be examined.

## #5→0

A [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|reflective return]] brings products back into the worlds they change; those worlds depend on [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C62-Planetary-Computation|shared material and institutional conditions]]. Within a [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|region of encounter]], names and accounts retain prior contacts as conditions of later ones, while the participant can answer beyond what the inherited name allowed the account to expect.

In [The Prisoner](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world), the administered world persists across occupants: later Numbers Two inherit offices, records, permissions and expectations that shape what they and Six can do next. This makes the Village more than a venue for isolated exchanges. Its coercive closure also separates durable worldhood from reciprocal answerability. The comparison therefore asks whether an agentworld merely persists or whether those who inhabit it can return through its conditions strongly enough to change them.

The [passage of delegated work](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD-apportionment-and-economy.md#delegated-labour-distributes-capacity-and-return) distributes capacity and its return between participants. Durable offices and artifacts transmit capacities between occupants and sessions. Their return includes the permission, provenance and encountered consequence which can change the next commission; the brief’s institutional scenarios retain their modality.
